name: ISFET sensors measurement data for soil nutrient analysis
description: The experimental measurement data was generated during the development, investigation, and validation of new readout electronics for a multi-sensor module, also known as a lab-on-chip. The purpose was to analyse the output measurement signal for signal stability, measurement dynamics, and signal reproducibility.
keywords: ISFET sensor, soil nutrients analysis, ion-sensitive sensor

citation.name: Tsukor, V., Hinck, S., Nietfeld, W., Lorenz, F., Najdenko, E., Möller, A., Mentrup, D., Mosler, T., Ruckelshausen, A.: Automated mobile field laboratory for on-the-go soil-nutrient analysis with the ISFET multi-sensor module. ISBN: 978-3-18-092361-1
